ops.note: Law: per-epoch latency 231 edges (36 rows, 44 words), minimum epoch period 224 (P<=223: epoch 1 source issues no reads, srcerr 16; P>=224 PASS). T = 231 + 224 x (epochs - 1) + 1; 512 rows -> 3,359 edges, so 6.2 edges/row/slice in steady state. The old law of 1039.9/1559.6 for 8192 rows per rank (incl. 143 wire + 28) is 2.03-3.05 cyc per slice row: the measured value is 2.2-3.2x the old price. At TOK2 default spacing P=600 the span is 8,623. The epoch floor comes from the XS source/element cfg->go (not the frame return window, which is 31 edges/epoch).
